::: {.callout-warning}

NOT YET IMPLEMENTED: This page will show how to stage the dataset using bare symlinks.


:::


This page shows the manual page contract in the context of a real staging task.

The operator must:

1. confirm that the project is ready to receive the staged data;
2. create the staged input location;
3. verify that the staged path now exists and points where expected.

## 1. Prerequisite

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm Required State"}

Before running this page, confirm that the project already exists and that the
operator is working from its root.

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

assert Path("README.md").exists(), "Expected README.md to exist before staging data."
Path("data").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
```

:::

## 2. Procedure

::: {.manual-procedure title="Declare The Target Dataset"}

Record the dataset identifier and the intended staging location.

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

dataset_name = "example_registered_dataset"
stage_path = Path("data") / dataset_name
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Create The Staging Link"}

Create the staged location. In a real manual this could call `stagecoach` or
another institutional tool.

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

dataset_name = "example_registered_dataset"
stage_path = Path("data") / dataset_name

stage_path.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
```

:::

## 3. Check

::: {.manual-check title="Verify Stage Result"}

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

dataset_name = "example_registered_dataset"
stage_path = Path("data") / dataset_name

assert stage_path.exists(), "Expected staged dataset path to exist."
assert stage_path.is_dir(), "Expected staged dataset path to be a directory."
```

:::

This page is intentionally small. It demonstrates that the framework still
works when the workflow itself is simple.
